data.name: A11y_KeyboardMode
data.value: Nexus Island keyboard mode. Tab moves between buttons, left and right arrows change page, Escape exits.

data.name: Hotkey_Done
data.value: Done: {0} shows and hides the island.

data.name: Hotkey_Help
data.value: Use Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win + a key. Esc to cancel.

data.name: Hotkey_NeedModifier
data.value: A modifier is missing (Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win): a single key would interfere with your typing.

data.name: Hotkey_Taken
data.value: {0} is already used by another app or Windows. Keeping {1}.

data.name: Settings_AlertCpu
data.value: CPU at 90 % or more for 30 seconds

data.name: Settings_AlertsHint
data.value: The island checks itself every 3 seconds and only alerts when needed. The 'System' panel (tools button) is always available.

data.name: Settings_Floating
data.value: It's now loose where you left it. Pick a monitor to dock it at the top center again.

data.name: Settings_HasIdentity
data.value: The island has package identity: it can read notifications (if you granted permission).

data.name: Settings_HideFullscreen
data.value: Hide the island when an app is full screen

data.name: Settings_IgnoredHint
data.value: The island doesn't show playback from these apps (handy for WhatsApp, Discord or browsers that aren't your music player). Apps that played something since the island started are listed.

data.name: Settings_MutedHint
data.value: Apps are muted from the island ('Mute' button). Uncheck an app to see it again.

data.name: Settings_NoApps
data.value: No app detected yet. Play something and click Refresh.

data.name: Settings_NoIdentity
data.value: No package identity: Windows doesn't allow reading notifications. See tools\register-identity.ps1 in the README.

data.name: Settings_NotifyTrack
data.value: Show the song for a few seconds when it changes

data.name: Settings_PositionHint
data.value: Docked at the top center of the chosen monitor. You can also drag it with the mouse: if you drop it far from the center, it stays loose there.

data.name: Settings_ShowContentHint
data.value: If you turn it off, the island only says which app it's from (handy when sharing your screen).

data.name: Settings_StartupBlocked
data.value: Windows has Nexus Island's startup turned off (Task Manager → Startup apps). Turn it on there for this to work.

data.name: Settings_StartupError
data.value: Couldn't change start with Windows. The details are in the log.

data.name: Settings_TasksHint
data.value: Only things lasting more than 3 seconds show up. Downloads show size and speed (browsers don't report the total); Explorer copies show the percentage.

data.name: Settings_TranslatorHint
data.value: Translates copied text between English and Spanish on this PC (Tools → Translate). The models are downloaded the first time you use each direction (≈ 110 MB each) and run in a separate process that closes after 2 minutes without use. Models: Opus-MT by Helsinki-NLP (CC BY 4.0).
